desc: Ideate approaches and select the direct sweep-line dominance check as the primary method.
Implement the direct sweep-line dominance check with fast input, O(M log M) time, and O(M) memory.
Run the provided sample tests and confirm the program reads stdin and writes Yes/No correctly.
If the sample tests fail, switch to an alternative approach (e.g., row-boundary feasibility or Fenwick dominance queries) instead of refining the same idea.
Handle edge cases: same-row and same-column conflicts, only black cells, only white cells, column 1/N, large N with sparse constraints, and M=1.
